body.p: Two shamans. Two persons live. Two shamans: one of them is an Enets shaman, the other one is a Tungus shaman. They do not live well among themselves, they constantly find fault with each other. One of them says: "If I want to, I will eat you alive", the other says: "If I want to, I will eat you alive", and that one says: "If I want to, I will eat you alive". Once the Enets said: "Obviously, it's not good for us to stay like this, it would, obviously, be good for us to go to the goose land. We don't seem to be able to live well on this earth." When they finished talking, each of them went to his own tent. Two shamans: one of them lives in one place, and the other one lives in another place. The Enets shaman said to his wife: "Now I will go to the goose land, when it will be spring, make me a tent, a tent for shaman practice. Make me such a thing. Make me a tent, if I am alive, if I come back alive, I will sit down into my tent." His wife said: "By the time you arrive, if you come back alive, of course, I will make you a tent." The Tungus shaman also said to his wife: "We will now leave for the goose land, we will go to the goose land. We can't live together here at all, we are constantly finding fault with each other." My friend says: "I will eat you", I also say to my friend: "I will eat you". After some time, the Enets flew out of his tent somewhere, apparently, he became a swan. The Enets became like that, he appeared above the tent of his friend, he appeared above the tent of his friend. The Enets said: "Come on, get ready. Get ready, I am going to the goose land." The Tungus shaman also flew out through the smoke hole and became a loon. He cried several times in the voice of a loon. Well, that's what he probably said to his family: "By the time I come, make me a tent." These shamans went to the goose land. There are many birds in the goose land, they also mixed with them. Now they said: "We're going to shed our feathers like our mates." The swan is now among his fellow swans, the loon is among his fellow loons. The loon swims there in the water, catches fish. There are people there too, so some get entangles into the fishing nets. But the loon does not know how to shed feathers, her feathers did not fall out, they were strong. He always swam with his feathers. After a while, the swan's feathers fell out, the swan tumbles without feathers, and the loon is very agile, catches fish. He occasionally meets his friend. He says to his friend: "You usually say, I'm more agile than you are, I can eat you." The swan said: "I'm cold." The swan said: "That's why I don't want to, I'm cold, after all." The swan said: "I'm cold, you see, I don't have a feather, my clothes came out, but your clothes are fine, your clothes are strong, you swim in the water.". The swan said to the loon: "Don't get caught in the net, otherwise you will stay here." The loon says: "Why should I stay here, after all, I'll go home somehow." After some time, while fishing, the loon got into the net, he was caught by people. And the swan, no matter how cold it was for him, was here until its legs grew. He got, of course, new feathers. After he got new feathers, the swan said: "The weather has become spring, now it seems to be warm, it would be good for me to go to my place.". The swan finally reached his place, he is circling over the smoke hole of his tent, he circled around it several times, screaming like a swan. After a while, his wife ran outside, wondering if her family member had returned. Well, finally the Enets went into his tent. When he sat down into the tent, he had there all sorts of items for shaman's practice there, a tambourine and something else. After a while, the sound of his tambourine was heard. The sound of his tambourine is heard for a long time. His friends came and began to ask him: "You have come, but where is your friend?". "My comrade was caught into a fishing net in that place, in the sea, I don't know if he will get out.". Some people said: "Who got into the net, how will he come, no, it looks like he won't come." The Enets said: "I think he might come. He will come. It belongs to a very strong clan of birds, to the clan of loons. His name will be a loon. And I will be a swan. I will soon become like this: my clan will be the source of life for all people, and in the future no one will catch the loon unnecessarily: its meat is not suitable for food, the skin is tough, not a single person will need a loon. Wait for the loon in the future. You will recognize him by his Tungus appearance."
